interpretation: The alpha tradeoff should appear in the 10D GMM under the population limit of the paper's h=0.6 KDE score estimator.
pass_condition: At generation 20, 95% confidence intervals for within-component dispersion are strictly ordered alpha 0.1 > 0.5 > 0.9; stochastic samples agree with the independently derived population closure within six standard errors; setting h=0 removes the tradeoff; cumulative runner exits zero.
verdict_rule: Even a passing route remains BLOCKED for full C6 because it replaces the finite empirical KDE and 500-step solver and does not run either image dataset.
